current_regime.trend_range_state: TRANSITIONAL: Sep 2/8 clearly range-bound; Sep 16 slipped below range; Sep 21 rebounded >10% and touched ~$86k. Do not encode a stable single regime from this sequence.
current_regime.spot_perp_taker_flow: Sep 14 spot/perp CVD showed aggressive selling; by Sep 21 spot and perp taker flow flipped to net buying.
current_regime.funding_basis: Sep 21 futures funding was above its high band. CME carry had rebuilt in July, but basis/carry remains a separate market-neutral sleeve.
current_regime.oi_leverage: Sep 21 futures OI was above high band; options OI also elevated. The rebound included short liquidations.
current_regime.realized_vs_implied_vol: Regime flipped across September: Coinbase Sep 3 reported realized far below implied/VRP +15.1v, while Glassnode Sep 8/14/21 reported negative volatility spread with realized above implied. This instability argues against a static vol threshold.
current_regime.liquidity_depth: Sep 16 Glassnode reported resting bids concentrated within ~10% and thinner depth below; Sep 21 rally was partly liquidation-assisted.
current_regime.onchain_flows: Sep 16 new demand had stalled across realized-cap inflows, ETFs, stablecoins and treasuries; Sep 21 ETF flow remained the major dissenting indicator even as spot/perp buying improved.
current_regime.macro_risk: Sep 3–16 sources show high global term premia, oil/geopolitical supply shocks and FOMC/event risk as material; treat as regime context, not a directional rule.
